title: unionclef 0.95.52
subtitle: dodging arrows by lava and a drop
caption: unionclef 0.95.52: arrow dodging picks a step via tungsten's physics simulation -- 18 key combinations tested against the arrow's flight, lava, fire and drops deeper than 3 blocks are filtered out. On a ledge between lava and a drop: went from 28-36 hp of damage over 10 arrows to 0-4, not a single step into lava or off the edge. Also: the bucket portal now searches the whole world for a lava lake. github.com/3ndetz/unionclef/releases/tag/v0.95.52
